sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: One year ago, Houston thought it was prepared for Hurricane Harvey.
sentences.zh: 一年前，休斯顿以为自己已经为哈维飓风做好了准备。

sentences.en: Now, as another major hurricane approaches the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，随着另一场大型飓风逼近美国

sentences.en: coast, the story of how Harvey's floodwaters overwhelmed Houston's emergency systems and how one family found out they were on their own.
sentences.zh: 海岸，我们来讲述哈维的洪水如何淹没了休斯顿的应急系统，以及一个家庭如何发现自己陷入了孤立无援的境地。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, September 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月13日，星期四。

sentences.en: I've always been fascinated with weather ever since I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 我从小就一直对天气很着迷。

sentences.en: Me and my uncle, we used to go chase tornadoes.
sentences.zh: 我和我叔叔过去常去追逐龙卷风。

sentences.en: I remember this one time, I remember, I don't even know how old I was, I was like eight or nine, something like that.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次，我甚至不知道自己当时多大，大概八九岁吧，差不多那样。

sentences.en: We were down in the ditch and we were watching these tornadoes.
sentences.zh: 我们待在沟里，看着那些龙卷风。

sentences.en: There were just three of them just like in a line, just moving across the sky.
sentences.zh: 有三个龙卷风排成一行，在天空中移动。

sentences.en: It was amazing.
sentences.zh: 太壮观了。

sentences.en: I like watching the thunderheads and the supercells form and the clouds and when the air masses mixed and then just watching how the clouds just change colors
sentences.zh: 我喜欢看雷暴云和超级单体形成，看云层，看气团混合，然后看着云彩变色

sentences.en: and change shape and forms and then the wind picks up and it gets cool and you can just feel the pressure change in the air and the smell, you know, it's just fresh.
sentences.zh: 变形状，然后风力增强，天气变凉，你能感觉到空气中气压的变化，还有那种气味，你知道，就是那种清新的感觉。

sentences.en: It's a fresh smell.
sentences.zh: 那是一种清新的气味。

sentences.en: It's a fresh, clean smell.
sentences.zh: 一种清新、干净的气味。

sentences.en: It's like it's alive, but it's not alive.
sentences.zh: 感觉它好像有生命，但其实又没有。

sentences.en: It doesn't have a heartbeat and a soul, but it's like it does, you know.
sentences.zh: 它没有心跳和灵魂，但感觉就像有一样，你懂吗。

sentences.en: It's like a living, breathing thing that just forms and has all this power, you know.
sentences.zh: 它就像一个活生生的、会呼吸的东西，就这样形成并拥有如此强大的力量，你懂吗。

sentences.en: It's like looking at an exotic animal like a lion or a tiger or something, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像看着一只异国动物，比如狮子、老虎之类的，你懂吗。

sentences.en: It's majestic and powerful, but you don't want to cross it because it's going to tear you up, you know.
sentences.zh: 它威严而强大，但你不想去招惹它，因为它会把你撕碎，你懂吗。

sentences.en: You can oo and aah it, but don't go try to pet it.
sentences.zh: 你可以惊叹于它，但别去试图抚摸它。

sentences.en: It is August 23rd, 2017 and Wayne Daly is sitting in the waiting area at Memorial
sentences.zh: 那是2017年8月23日，韦恩·戴利正坐在位于休斯顿的纪念赫尔曼医院的候诊区。

sentences.en: Herman Hospital, which is right in Houston.
sentences.zh: 纪念赫尔曼医院，就在休斯顿。

sentences.en: Sherry Fink reported this story for the Times magazine.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·芬克为《时代》杂志报道了这个故事。

sentences.en: The waiting room was pretty full.
sentences.zh: 候诊室里相当拥挤。

sentences.en: You know, it was busy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很忙碌。

sentences.en: People are coming in and out.
sentences.zh: 人们进进出出。

sentences.en: Doctors are calling people out to give them updates.
sentences.zh: 医生们叫人出去告知最新情况。

sentences.en: Wayne is there with his sister and they look up at the television as a distraction.
sentences.zh: 韦恩和他的姐姐在那里，他们抬头看着电视来分散注意力。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Well, we've got some severe weather to talk about.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们有一些恶劣天气要谈谈。

sentences.en: Also possible.
sentences.zh: 也有可能。

sentences.en: On the TV, they had the news on.
sentences.zh: 电视上正在播放新闻。

sentences.en: Tropical weather.
sentences.zh: 热带天气。

sentences.en: We're watching
sentences.zh: 我们正在关注

sentences.en: Harvey flooding.
sentences.zh: 哈维带来的洪水。

sentences.en: Very possible.
sentences.zh: 很有可能。

sentences.en: And in fact, of course, everybody's watching Hurricane Harvey
sentences.zh: 事实上，当然，每个人都在关注哈维飓风

sentences.en: and Michelle and I both look at each other and say, well, it's going to hit us.
sentences.zh: 我和米歇尔互相对视一眼，说，好吧，它要袭击我们了。

sentences.en: You know, we both know it's coming.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们都知道它要来了。

sentences.en: Look at this.
sentences.zh: 看这个。

sentences.en: We've got rainfall amounts of up to 10 inches.
sentences.zh: 降雨量高达10英寸。

sentences.en: So we're going to be watching this very, very carefully.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将非常、非常仔细地观察这个情况。

sentences.en: And were you nervous about the storm?
sentences.zh: 你当时对这场风暴感到紧张吗？

sentences.en: No, actually, the storm was the least of my worries.
sentences.zh: 不，实际上，风暴是我最不担心的事情。

sentences.en: I wasn't, I had, I wasn't worried about Harvey one bit.
sentences.zh: 我没有，我有，我一点也不担心哈维。

sentences.en: Daily producer Annie Brown spoke with Wayne and Sherry about this story.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》制片人安妮·布朗与韦恩和雪莉谈到了这个故事。

sentences.en: At this moment, the main thing I'm worried about is Casey.
sentences.zh: 此刻，我最担心的是凯西。

sentences.en: He was worried about his wife.
sentences.zh: 他担心的是他的妻子。

sentences.en: She was in surgery.
sentences.zh: 她正在接受手术。

sentences.en: She's only 38 years old.
sentences.zh: 她才38岁。

sentences.en: It was this moment of, oh my God, is the surgeon as skilled as he said he is?
sentences.zh: 当时那一刻，我心想，天哪，外科医生真的像他说的那样技术高超吗？

sentences.en: Is the surgery going to do what he said it would do?
sentences.zh: 手术会达到他所说的效果吗？

sentences.en: My main worry was her crashing on the operating table.
sentences.zh: 我最担心的是她在手术台上出事。

sentences.en: And so that's what was going through my head the whole entire time was that.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我整个过程中脑子里一直在想的事情。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could tell me about meeting your wife for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我想请你讲讲第一次见到你妻子的情景。

sentences.en: Well, to be honest with you, I don't really remember meeting her the first time because
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不记得第一次见到她是什么时候了，因为

sentences.en: the first time I met her was in high school because we had an English and we had a math class together at Sea King High School.
sentences.zh: 我第一次见到她是在高中，因为我们在海王高中一起上过英语课和数学课。

sentences.en: I sat right next to her.
sentences.zh: 我就坐在她旁边。

sentences.en: And at that point in time, I was the new kid.
sentences.zh: 当时，我是个转校生。

sentences.en: I was the annoying kid who was just making problems with everybody else.
sentences.zh: 我是那个烦人的孩子，总是给别人制造麻烦。

sentences.en: But the first time I really actually saw Casey for the very first time, I think I was 17, that's 18.
sentences.zh: 但我真正第一次看到凯西，我想我当时17岁，或者18岁。

sentences.en: And I was sitting out on the front porch, smoking a cigarette.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在前廊抽烟。

sentences.en: And I seen this little blue Cavalier pull up and see this woman, this girl get out, woman.
sentences.zh: 我看到一辆蓝色的小卡瓦利尔车停下来，看到这个女人，这个女孩走出来，女人。

sentences.en: I guess you can call her a woman.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以叫她女人。

sentences.en: She was 18.
sentences.zh: 她18岁。

sentences.en: She has some of this beautiful hair and it's long, curly, wavy.
sentences.zh: 她有一头漂亮的头发，又长又卷，波浪形的。

sentences.en: And it's like one of those moments you see like on
sentences.zh: 就像你在电视上看到的那种时刻，

sentences.en: TV where the hot chick gets out the car and kind of swings her hair back and the wind catches it, you know.
sentences.zh: 辣妹从车里走出来，甩了一下头发，风吹过她的头发，你懂的。

sentences.en: It kind of slows down.
sentences.zh: 画面好像变慢了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: It was one of those things.
sentences.zh: 就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: I was starstruck, you know.
sentences.zh: 我被迷住了，你知道。

sentences.en: And I was just like, who is that?
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，那是谁？

sentences.en: And I was looked at and I said, I want to marry that woman one day.
sentences.zh: 我看着她，对自己说，我总有一天要娶那个女人。

sentences.en: The way he phrases it is, I could not not look at her.
sentences.zh: 他表达的方式是，我无法不看着她。

sentences.en: She just electrified him.
sentences.zh: 她让他感到触电般的感觉。

sentences.en: So they do marry and they end up moving into the trailer where she grew up on the street called Enchanted Path Drive.
sentences.zh: 于是他们结婚了，最后搬进了她从小长大的拖车房，就在一条叫“魔法小径”的街上。

sentences.en: They start raising their kids together and they have a lot of romance.
sentences.zh: 他们开始一起抚养孩子，生活充满了浪漫。

sentences.en: I knew what time she always got home and I cleaned the entire house, did the dishes, did the floors.
sentences.zh: 我知道她什么时候回家，我打扫了整个房子，洗了碗，拖了地。

sentences.en: I had dinner cooked.
sentences.zh: 我做好了晚饭。

sentences.en: I went out and bought her a bunch of CDs.
sentences.zh: 我出去给她买了一堆CD。

sentences.en: He describes how sometimes she'd come home from work and he'd have candles lit.
sentences.zh: 他描述了有时她下班回家，他会点上蜡烛。

sentences.en: And then she walked in the door, she was just like, just breath took, you know.
sentences.zh: 然后她走进门，她就只是，屏住了呼吸，你知道。

sentences.en: And they would slow dance.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会跳慢舞。

sentences.en: It would be in the living room area on the rug or carpet.
sentences.zh: 就在客厅的地毯上。

sentences.en: To their song, Pearl Jam's Just Breathe.
sentences.zh: 伴着他们的歌，珍珠果酱乐队的《Just Breathe》。

sentences.en: She would have her arms underneath my arms wrapped around me and I'd have my arms around
sentences.zh: 她会把双臂伸到我的腋下环抱着我，我会用双臂

sentences.en: basically her whole entire head with her pulled into my cheSt. Just hold her close and she would
sentences.zh: 基本上环住她的整个头，把她拉进我的胸口。就这样紧紧抱着她，她会

sentences.en: nuzzle her head into my chest and I'd lean my head on top of hers and we would just slow dance around in circles until the song was over, until we felt like we were done.
sentences.zh: 把头蹭进我的胸口，我把头靠在她的头上，我们就这样绕着圈跳慢舞，直到歌放完，直到我们觉得跳够了。

sentences.en: She was about the only woman I really ever danced with.
sentences.zh: 她是我真正跳过舞的唯一一个女人。

sentences.en: She brought that out of me.
sentences.zh: 是她激发了我这一面。

sentences.en: She made me not afraid to do anything.
sentences.zh: 她让我不再害怕做任何事。

sentences.en: Looking like a fool was cool, you know.
sentences.zh: 看起来像个傻瓜也没关系，你知道。

sentences.en: They didn't have a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 他们没什么钱。

sentences.en: Wayne spent years working these really dangerous jobs in excavation and on oil rigs.
sentences.zh: 韦恩多年来一直从事挖掘和石油钻井平台上那些非常危险的工作。

sentences.en: Casey would try to supplement their income.
sentences.zh: 凯西会试图补贴家用。

sentences.en: She would scrap junk metal and buy the cheapest things.
sentences.zh: 她会去捡废金属，买最便宜的东西。

sentences.en: But they had this generosity.
sentences.zh: 但他们非常慷慨。

sentences.en: If you looked at it from outside, you wouldn't know how much they struggled.
sentences.zh: 如果你从外面看，你不会知道他们挣扎得有多辛苦。

sentences.en: One of their children had a best friend whose parents were going through a rough patch.
sentences.zh: 他们的一个孩子有个好朋友，那孩子的父母正经历一段艰难时期。

sentences.en: So they actually took him in so that he wouldn't have to go off to foster care.
sentences.zh: 所以他们实际上收留了他，这样他就不用去寄养家庭了。

sentences.en: There would be strangers sleeping on their living room floor, people who were evicted.
sentences.zh: 经常有陌生人睡在他们客厅的地板上，那些被驱逐的人。

sentences.en: There were all sorts of ways that they stood for generosity.
sentences.zh: 他们以各种方式展现了慷慨。

sentences.en: When did you first notice that something was not quite right with Casey and her health?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候第一次注意到凯西的健康出了问题的？

sentences.en: That was right after we had our second child, Ronnie, in 2006.
sentences.zh: 那是在我们2006年生下第二个孩子罗尼之后。

sentences.en: Casey started to develop health problems in her 30s.
sentences.zh: 凯西在30多岁时开始出现健康问题。

sentences.en: One of the things she experienced was weight gain.
sentences.zh: 她经历的事情之一是体重增加。

sentences.en: It wasn't like weight from not eating right and taking care of herself.
sentences.zh: 那不是因为饮食不当或不照顾自己而导致的体重增加。

sentences.en: It was showing up like in the top of her shoulders and, you know, it was showing up in her face and in her neck.
sentences.zh: 它出现在她的肩膀上，你知道，出现在她的脸上和脖子上。

sentences.en: And it just seemed like it was something that was wrong.
sentences.zh: 看起来好像出了什么问题。

sentences.en: She had other symptoMs. She was nauseous.
sentences.zh: 她还有其他症状。她感到恶心。

sentences.en: She had back pain.
sentences.zh: 她背痛。

sentences.en: Her stomach developed these weird red lines.
sentences.zh: 她的肚子上出现了奇怪的红线。

sentences.en: Her mood started to get really erratic.
sentences.zh: 她的情绪开始变得非常不稳定。

sentences.en: And then sometimes it would seem like it wasn't even her.
sentences.zh: 有时看起来甚至不像她自己了。

sentences.en: It was somebody else that was inside her coming out, you know.
sentences.zh: 好像是另一个人在她体内显露出来，你知道。

sentences.en: All sorts of symptoMs. And it was a diabetic doctor who actually discovered the cortisol levels and the tumor.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的症状。是一位糖尿病医生发现了皮质醇水平和肿瘤。

sentences.en: There's this kind of tumor you can have that grows in your adrenal gland.
sentences.zh: 有一种肿瘤会生长在肾上腺上。

sentences.en: And hers was producing hormones.
sentences.zh: 她的肿瘤在产生激素。

sentences.en: And the hormones were the cause of all these various mysterious health probleMs. She had something called Cushing syndrome, which is rare, but it's curable
sentences.zh: 这些激素是所有这些各种神秘健康问题的原因。她患有一种叫库欣综合征的病，很罕见，但可以通过切除长有肿瘤的肾上腺来治愈。

sentences.en: by removing the adrenal gland that has the tumor in it.
sentences.zh: 切除长有肿瘤的肾上腺。

sentences.en: They had us in pre-op marking on her with a permanent marker where the tumor was located, where they were going to make the incisions at.
sentences.zh: 他们在术前准备时，用永久性记号笔在她身上标记出肿瘤的位置，以及他们要切开的地方。

sentences.en: So that's why Casey and Wayne were in the hospital that day.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么凯西和韦恩那天在医院的原因。

sentences.en: I went out to the waiting room and they took her back to the operating room.
sentences.zh: 我去了候诊室，他们把她带回了手术室。

sentences.en: Took like an hour and a half.
sentences.zh: 花了一个半小时。

sentences.en: The surgeon came out, called Wayne, showed him a picture of the tumor on his phone because Wayne was curious.
sentences.zh: 外科医生出来叫了韦恩，在手机上给他看了肿瘤的照片，因为韦恩很好奇。

sentences.en: And to Wayne, it looks really big.
sentences.zh: 对韦恩来说，它看起来很大。

sentences.en: It's like the size of his two thumbs put together.
sentences.zh: 就像他两个大拇指合在一起那么大。

sentences.en: But to the surgeon, everything looks good.
sentences.zh: 但对医生来说，一切看起来都很好。

sentences.en: Looks like it's going to be benign.
sentences.zh: 看起来应该是良性的。

sentences.en: He really feels that this will solve Casey's probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他真的觉得这能解决凯西的问题。

sentences.en: There must've been a lot of relief that the surgery went well and it was over.
sentences.zh: 手术顺利结束，你一定感到如释重负吧。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You could see it on her face.
sentences.zh: 你可以从她的脸上看出来。

sentences.en: You know, you could just see it in her, you know, just everything about her.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以从她身上看出来，你知道，关于她的一切。

sentences.en: You could see that there was just so much weight lifted off of her from that.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出，那件事让她卸下了沉重的负担。

sentences.en: And how was Casey feeling when you got home from the hospital?
sentences.zh: 你从医院回家时，凯西感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: She was feeling good.
sentences.zh: 她感觉不错。

sentences.en: I mean, she was sore from the surgery, but you know, as far as her outlook and just everything, she was real positive, optimistic.
sentences.zh: 我是说，手术后她身体很痛，但你知道，就她的心态和各方面而言，她真的很积极、很乐观。

sentences.en: She was looking forward to getting healed up.
sentences.zh: 她很期待康复。

sentences.en: And she was like, all right, you know, it's day one of, of recovery.
sentences.zh: 她当时说，好吧，你知道，这是康复的第一天。

sentences.en: And she was real optimistic about it.
sentences.zh: 她对此非常乐观。

sentences.en: Now I'm going to go to Transtar for a news conference featuring the mayor and the Harris County judge.
sentences.zh: 现在我要去Transtar参加一场新闻发布会，市长和哈里斯县法官会出席。

sentences.en: They're going to give an update on the circumstances and the preparations for both the county and the city.
sentences.zh: 他们将通报县市两级的最新情况和准备工作。

sentences.en: You see Harris County judge Ed Emmett there waiting.
sentences.zh: 你看，哈里斯县法官埃德·埃米特正在那里等候。

sentences.en: So the top official for the county and the mayor of Houston.
sentences.zh: 所以这是县里的最高官员和休斯顿市长。

sentences.en: This is a rainmaker.
sentences.zh: 这可是场大雨。

sentences.en: Some say 15 to 25, some say 20 to 30.
sentences.zh: 有人说15到25英寸，有人说20到30英寸。

sentences.en: We simply do not know.
sentences.zh: 我们实在无法确定。

sentences.en: We're going to hope and pray for the beSt. They warn the public.
sentences.zh: 我们只能祈祷一切顺利。他们向公众发出了警告。

sentences.en: This is really looking like we're going to get a lot of rain.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们真的要迎来一场大雨了。

sentences.en: Especially Saturday, Saturday.
sentences.zh: 尤其是周六，周六。

sentences.en: There's going to be flooding.
sentences.zh: 会有洪水的。

sentences.en: Just stay off the roads.
sentences.zh: 最好别出门。

sentences.en: I think that's the best thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是最好的办法。

sentences.en: Just stay off the roads.
sentences.zh: 最好别出门。

sentences.en: Stay alert.
sentences.zh: 保持警惕。

sentences.en: Stay safe.
sentences.zh: 注意安全。

sentences.en: And if you don't mind this coming from the mayor, never hurts to pray for those that are in the hurricane's way and for this city.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意市长这么说的话，为那些处于飓风路径上的人们和这座城市祈祷，总归没坏处。

sentences.en: We've been through so many of these hurricanes that we don't get worried about them.
sentences.zh: 我们经历过太多次飓风了，所以我们并不担心。

sentences.en: We just get ready for them.
sentences.zh: 我们只是做好准备。

sentences.en: You know, make sure we got plenty of food and fill up the bathtubs and the toilets and the washing machine and five gallon jugs of water.
sentences.zh: 你知道，确保我们有充足的食物，把浴缸、马桶、洗衣机和五加仑的水桶都装满水。

sentences.en: Freeze a bunch of jugs of ice and candles.
sentences.zh: 冻上一堆冰块，准备好蜡烛。

sentences.en: We have hurricane lamps.
sentences.zh: 我们有飓风灯。

sentences.en: Flashlights and tons of batteries.
sentences.zh: 手电筒和成吨的电池。

sentences.en: Lots of blankets and pillows and clothes.
sentences.zh: 还有大量的毯子、枕头和衣服。

sentences.en: And basically that's all you do.
sentences.zh: 基本上这就是你要做的全部。

sentences.en: And just, just wait it out.
sentences.zh: 然后就等着风暴过去。

sentences.en: The day after Casey gets home,
sentences.zh: 凯西回家后的第二天，

sentences.en: Friday night, the storm hit the coaSt. And then Saturday night is when its effects really started being felt in Houston.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上，风暴袭击了海岸。周六晚上，休斯顿才真正开始感受到它的影响。

sentences.en: And Wayne is keeping vigil and he actually records this.
sentences.zh: 韦恩一直在守候，他甚至录下了这一切。

sentences.en: He opens the screen door.
sentences.zh: 他打开纱门。

sentences.en: The rain is sheeting down.
sentences.zh: 雨像倾盆一样落下。

sentences.en: There are these crashes of thunder.
sentences.zh: 雷声阵阵。

sentences.en: Lightning is just shocking the trees into sudden light, you know, even though it's dark and in the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 闪电把树木照得忽明忽暗，你知道，尽管现在是深夜，外面一片漆黑。

sentences.en: It's really coming down, man.
sentences.zh: 雨下得真大，伙计。

sentences.en: Our street has about two and a half foot of water on it.
sentences.zh: 我们街上的积水大约有两英尺半深。

sentences.en: He's watching, he's watching every few hours.
sentences.zh: 他一直在观察，每隔几个小时就看一次。

sentences.en: What level is the water getting to in the street?
sentences.zh: 街上的水位到哪了？

sentences.en: Is the street starting to flood?
sentences.zh: 街道开始被淹了吗？

sentences.en: When he gets back to his phone, it says, flash flood warning, imminent threat, severe.
sentences.zh: 当他回到手机旁时，上面显示：山洪预警，迫在眉睫，情况严重。

sentences.en: Still got power.
sentences.zh: 还有电。

sentences.en: Still got phones, food, water,
sentences.zh: 还有手机信号、食物、水，

sentences.en: everything we need.
sentences.zh: 我们所需的一切都有。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could describe for me how Casey's health changed over that first day.
sentences.zh: 我想请你描述一下凯西在第一天里健康状况是如何变化的。

sentences.en: Well, after the first day, she was good.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第一天之后，她还好。

sentences.en: You know, like I said, she was sore and tired and, you know, drained and everything, but her spirits were high.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我说的，她很痛、很累，你知道，精疲力竭之类的，但她的精神状态很好。

sentences.en: She was talking on the phone with her mom, you know, and everybody else, and everybody knows she's okay.
sentences.zh: 她和她妈妈通了电话，你知道，还有其他人，大家都知道她没事。

sentences.en: And the second day, she was good.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她也还好。

sentences.en: Here's the latest update.
sentences.zh: 这是最新消息。

sentences.en: A lot of the neighbors in my neighborhood are trying to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我社区里的很多邻居都在试图离开这里。

sentences.en: A little more pain this time because now that the anesthesia is wearing off, you know, totally.
sentences.zh: 这次疼痛感更强了，因为麻醉药效完全消失了。

sentences.en: But then the third day after surgery, she was in a lot of pain.
sentences.zh: 但手术后的第三天，她感到非常痛苦。

sentences.en: It is pretty bad, buddy.
sentences.zh: 情况相当糟糕，伙计。

sentences.en: She had this little bitty, this little round little patch thing.
sentences.zh: 她身上贴着一个小小的、圆圆的贴片。

sentences.en: It was on the back of her ear, and it was there to control nausea during surgery and after surgery.
sentences.zh: 它贴在她的耳后，用来控制手术期间和手术后的恶心感。

sentences.en: I could take it off after 72 hours.
sentences.zh: 72小时后我可以把它取下来。

sentences.en: So when I took it off of her ear, I mean, it was within a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 所以我把它从她耳朵上取下来后，没过几个小时，

sentences.en: She was just puking.
sentences.zh: 她就开始呕吐了。

sentences.en: She would puke for 15, 20 minutes, and then an hour would go by, and she'd puke for 15, 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 她会吐上15到20分钟，然后过一个小时，她又会吐上15到20分钟。

sentences.en: I was thinking that it was just the side effects from that anesthesia, and that's normal from taking the patch off.
sentences.zh: 我以为这只是麻醉的副作用，取下贴片后出现这种情况很正常。

sentences.en: But then probably about midday of her going through the vomiting, she started having some real major pains in her stomach.
sentences.zh: 但大概在她呕吐到中午的时候，她的胃开始剧烈疼痛。

sentences.en: She looked at me and the look in her eyes, and she said, there's something that's not right when you get to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 她看着我，眼神里透着那种神情，她说，当你到了医院，有些事情不对劲。

sentences.en: I need a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我需要医生。

sentences.en: That's when it got serious.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，情况变得严重了。

sentences.en: By Monday morning, the water had risen to their top step.
sentences.zh: 到周一早上，水位已经涨到了他们家最顶层的台阶。

sentences.en: And Wayne, when he went to check on Casey, he couldn't keep her awake.
sentences.zh: 韦恩去查看凯西时，发现怎么也叫不醒她。

sentences.en: He couldn't rouse her.
sentences.zh: 他无法唤醒她。

sentences.en: So he decided to call 9-1-1.
sentences.zh: 于是他决定拨打911。

sentences.en: 9-1-1 call, the first of five, Monday, August 28th, 1.29 p.m.
sentences.zh: 911通话，这是8月28日周一下午1点29分五次通话中的第一次。

sentences.en: 9-1-1 is the first line of defense in a disaster, making that connection from the person who needs
sentences.zh: 911是灾难中的第一道防线，它连接着需要帮助的人

sentences.en: help to police or fire that can do rescues or emergency medical services.
sentences.zh: 与能够进行救援或提供紧急医疗服务的警察或消防部门。

sentences.en: My wife recently had surgery last Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 我妻子上周三刚做了手术。

sentences.en: She had a tumor removed from her left kidney, and she has been very sick.
sentences.zh: 她切除了左肾的一个肿瘤，现在病得很重。

sentences.en: She's been vomiting for the past day and a half
sentences.zh: 她过去一天半一直在呕吐，

sentences.en: constantly, and she's in severe pain.
sentences.zh: 不停地吐，而且疼痛剧烈。

sentences.en: And she needs to be airlifted to a hospital.
sentences.zh: 她需要被空运到医院。

sentences.en: And normally, the call comes in, goes to the sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，电话打进来会转到警长办公室。

sentences.en: If it's not a police call, it gets transferred to a second 9-1-1 center where they're dispatching for fire and medical.
sentences.zh: 如果不是报警电话，就会转到第二个911中心，由他们调度消防和医疗救援。

sentences.en: Okay, let me get you over.
sentences.zh: 好的，我帮你转接。

sentences.en: Let's see, it's Sheldon's fire department.
sentences.zh: 让我看看，这是谢尔顿消防局。

sentences.en: Who is EMS?
sentences.zh: 谁是急救中心？

sentences.en: Is South Lake Houston EMS?
sentences.zh: 是南休斯顿急救中心吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so let me get you transferred over to South Lake Houston EMs. Let them know what's going on, okay?
sentences.zh: 好的，那我把你转接给南休斯顿急救中心。让他们知道发生了什么，好吗？

sentences.en: And normally, they're just trying to determine how dire is the situation?
sentences.zh: 通常他们只是试图确定情况有多危急？

sentences.en: How sick is this person?
sentences.zh: 这个人病得有多重？

sentences.en: How should we prioritize them?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何优先处理他们？

sentences.en: But what happened Sunday was that the call volume shot up so much, there was such a backup in these 9-1-1 calls that the leaders of this call center walked into the
sentences.zh: 但周日发生的情况是，通话量激增，911呼叫中心出现了严重的积压，以至于呼叫中心的领导走进

sentences.en: call floor, and they said, we're going to do something we've never done before.
sentences.zh: 呼叫大厅，他们说，我们要采取一种前所未有的做法。

sentences.en: We're going to suspend that whole prioritization system, that whole system of asking the caller questions and figuring out how dire is their situation.
sentences.zh: 我们要暂停整个优先级系统，即询问呼叫者问题并判断情况危急程度的整套系统。

sentences.en: And instead...
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是……

sentences.en: You're going to just get off the phone as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 你要尽快结束通话。

sentences.en: If it's a call for water rescue, here's the script.
sentences.zh: 如果是水上救援的电话，这是脚本。

sentences.en: You're going to read the script and then try to get off the phone because calls are just stacking up and stacking up.
sentences.zh: 你要读完脚本，然后尽量结束通话，因为电话实在是堆积如山。

sentences.en: And she's been vomiting for the past day and a half.
sentences.zh: 她过去一天半一直在呕吐。

sentences.en: Okay, how many people are in the house?
sentences.zh: 好的，家里有几个人？

sentences.en: I have two boys and me and my wife.
sentences.zh: 我有两个儿子，还有我和我妻子。

sentences.en: Okay, so four people?
sentences.zh: 好的，一共四个人？

sentences.en: The call taker, she cut him off, and she started reading the script.
sentences.zh: 接线员打断了他，开始照着脚本念。

sentences.en: Okay, we do have over 1,000 calls for service in this area for assistance with evacuation.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们在这个地区有超过1000个寻求疏散援助的求助电话。

sentences.en: And as soon as the fire department is able to make it to this area, then you will be evacuated, okay?
sentences.zh: 一旦消防部门能够到达这个区域，你们就会被疏散，好吗？

sentences.en: Okay, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right, I have my...
sentences.zh: 好的，我有我的……

sentences.en: And so as a result, at the end of Wayne's call, Casey is not tagged as an emergency medical case.
sentences.zh: 结果，在韦恩通话结束时，凯西并没有被标记为紧急医疗病例。

sentences.en: She's just put into this big queue of many hundreds, thousands of people calling about needing a water rescue.
sentences.zh: 她只是被放进了成百上千个请求水上救援的庞大队列中。

sentences.en: And how did you feel after this 911 call?
sentences.zh: 打完这个911电话后你感觉如何？

sentences.en: What did you think was going to happen at that point?
sentences.zh: 你当时觉得会发生什么？

sentences.en: Oh, well, at that point in time, I thought, okay, this is cool.
sentences.zh: 哦，嗯，当时我觉得，好吧，这下好了。

sentences.en: You know, this is going to be an easy thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这会很容易解决的。

sentences.en: They're going to be here in 15, 20 minutes, and we're going to be on our way to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们会在15到20分钟内赶到，然后我们就能去医院了。

sentences.en: And then they didn't show up.
sentences.zh: 结果他们没来。

sentences.en: So hours have gone by, and rescuers haven't shown up.
sentences.zh: 几个小时过去了，救援人员还没出现。

sentences.en: But then there was an airboat I heard outside.
sentences.zh: 但后来我听到外面有气垫船的声音。

sentences.en: What does it sound like?
sentences.zh: 听起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: I would just sound like a big, giant fan.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像一个巨大的风扇。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: I heard it, and so I opened the door, and I was waiting for him to come by.
sentences.zh: 我听到了，所以我打开门，等着他们经过。

sentences.en: He's next to his little son, and they're waving frantically.
sentences.zh: 他身边带着小儿子，他们疯狂地挥手。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I got their attention, and I told them that we need a rescue.
sentences.zh: 所以我引起了他们的注意，告诉他们我们需要救援。

sentences.en: I asked them if they were doing rescuing.
sentences.zh: 我问他们是否在进行救援。

sentences.en: I've got kids.
sentences.zh: 我有孩子。

sentences.en: I've got my wife.
sentences.zh: 我妻子也在。

sentences.en: She just had surgery.
sentences.zh: 她刚做完手术。

sentences.en: We have to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我们必须离开这里。

sentences.en: They said, yes, we're going to get a family out right now.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好的，我们现在正要带走一个家庭。

sentences.en: We'll be back to get you.
sentences.zh: 我们会回来接你们的。

sentences.en: And so at that time, I was like, okay, they'll be back.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，好吧，他们会回来的。

sentences.en: So he goes back into the bedroom where Casey is lying there.
sentences.zh: 于是他回到凯西躺着的卧室。

sentences.en: She's in a lot of pain, and he says, Casey, we've got an airboat coming, and she kind of nods.
sentences.zh: 她非常痛苦，他说，凯西，气垫船要来了，她点了点头。

sentences.en: All right, as we wait for the airboat to come back for us, I'll just show y'all what it looks like.
sentences.zh: 好了，在我们等气垫船回来接我们的时候，我给你们看看外面的情况。

sentences.en: And he starts doing a Facebook Live because he knows the family's really worried about him.
sentences.zh: 他开始进行Facebook直播，因为他知道家人非常担心他。

sentences.en: Airboats will be here anytime now.
sentences.zh: 气垫船随时都会到。

sentences.en: In fact, I think I hear them now.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我想我现在听到他们的声音了。

sentences.en: So I'm going to go ahead and end the video, and I will keep y'all updated on what's going on.
sentences.zh: 所以我要结束视频了，我会随时向你们更新最新情况。

sentences.en: All right, here they are.
sentences.zh: 好了，他们来了。

sentences.en: But instead of turning onto Enchanted Path Drive, it keeps going.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有转进Enchanted Path Drive，而是继续向前开。

sentences.en: And he feels this wave of panic.
sentences.zh: 他感到一阵恐慌。

sentences.en: And soon after that, the electricity goes out.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，电力中断了。

sentences.en: On tomorrow's daily, part two of Wayne and Casey's story.
sentences.zh: 在明天的日报中，将播出韦恩和凯西故事的第二部分。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡，你愿意尝试吗？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在机会来了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》

sentences.en: Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 应用程序时，即可免费使用一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 这一个月里，你可以突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅用户每天都能读到什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载这款应用，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Russian President Vladimir Putin said his government had located the two suspects
sentences.zh: 周三，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京表示，他的政府已经找到了两名嫌疑人，

sentences.en: accused of trying to assassinate a former Russian spy living in England, Sergei Skripal.
sentences.zh: 他们被指控试图暗杀居住在英国的前俄罗斯间谍谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔。

sentences.en: Putin said the men, whom British authorities have identified as Russian intelligence officers, were civilians who had done nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 普京称，这两人虽然被英国当局认定为俄罗斯情报人员，但他们只是平民，并没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: Asked about the suspects during a live event in Russia, Putin did not deny their role in the attack, but said, quote, there is nothing especially interesting or criminal here.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯的一场现场活动中被问及这些嫌疑人时，普京并没有否认他们在袭击中的角色，而是引用原话称：“这里面没什么特别有趣或犯罪的事情。”

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时甚至令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我将与莎拉·凯尼格一起，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》节目。
